name: h3-longvideos
description: JARVIS workflow configuration for the installed MiniMax H3 LongVideos ComfyUI node (Smite79/MiniMax-H3-LongVideos). This file is the ONLY place the LongVideos ComfyUI graph is described. The Long Video Director fills in $placeholders; it never hardcodes the node graph itself, so the underlying workflow can be swapped without touching the director.

notes.prompt: Paragraph 1 is the SCENE (prepended to every shot). Every later paragraph is one beat = one shot. The node chains the shots internally: it decodes a beat, pins its final frame as the keyframe conditioning for the next beat, handles the seam, and returns ONE continuous video. JARVIS must never extract frames or concatenate clips itself.
notes.megapixels: 1.0 = H3's native pixel budget; lower is faster and leaner.
notes.shot_seconds: Maximum length of a single generated beat (1-15s). Beats are planned by the director at or below this cap.
notes.outputs: images + audio are already joined by the node. CreateVideo/SaveVideo only mux the finished result.
